title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A removal that did nothing, and said nothing
summary: The cascade added in 1.42.222 could ask to delete a file the same edit was already changing. VS Code rejects that whole edit without a word.

highlights.title: Deleted and edited at once
highlights.description: A WorkspaceEdit that both removes a URI and edits a range in it is rejected entirely and in silence, so the removal appeared to run and changed nothing.

highlights.title: Planned before anything is written
highlights.description: The cascade answers first, and the caller adds no range edit for a file the plan takes. One planner and one writer for the four places that remove code.

highlights.title: Reachable on every testOnly finding
highlights.description: A declaration used only from tests is never counted as removable, so the scan never marks its file as emptied, and the cascade was the only thing that knew.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The cascade is planned before any edit is written, so no URI is both deleted and edited.
A file the cascade takes receives no range edit, and exactly one deletion.
